description:

---------------------------------------------

At Penguin Solutions, we understand the boundless potential of technology and support our customers in turning cutting-edge ideas into outcomes—faster, and at any scale.

**Senior Manager, Software Engineering**
========================================

Date Posted: Oct 21, 2026

Requisition ID: 2225

Location:
Bangalore, IN, 560048

Brand: Penguin Solutions

At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) – The AI Factory Platform Company – we’re building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale.

Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision.

At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Manager, Software Engineering** to lead engineering teams building core capabilities of the **ClusterWareAI** platform, with strong exposure to **Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI**.

ClusterWareAI enables deployment, orchestration, monitoring, optimization, and lifecycle management of large-scale AI infrastructure. This role will lead engineering across distributed systems, Kubernetes, infrastructure orchestration, observability, and AI-enabled platform capabilities.

The ideal candidate is a strong engineering leader who can build high-performing teams, drive technical execution, and work closely with Data Science and AI teams to productionize intelligent capabilities.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will provide technical and organizational leadership, drive execution across multiple initiatives, develop engineering leaders, and help establish Bangalore as a key engineering center for ClusterWareAI.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, grow, and develop high-performing software engineering teams responsible for key components and services within the ClusterWareAI platform.
* Drive roadmap execution across multiple engineering initiatives from architecture and design through development, validation, release, and production support.
* Partner with Product Management, Principal Engineers, and Architects to define technical strategy, architecture, and execution priorities aligned with product and customer requirements.
* Partner with Data Science and AI teams to productionize ML models, analytics, GenAI, and agentic capabilities.
* Establish engineering practices for AI/ML reliability, observability, security, evaluation, and governance.
* Provide technical leadership for large-scale distributed systems and cloud-native platform capabilities spanning infrastructure orchestration, cluster management, APIs, Kubernetes, and AI infrastructure.
* Guide architectural decisions and technical trade-offs related to scalability, availability, performance, security, maintainability, and operational complexity.
* Drive the development of reliable control-plane services and APIs for provisioning, orchestration, monitoring, and lifecycle management of large-scale AI infrastructure.
* Champion engineering excellence through strong software architecture, code quality, test automation, CI/CD, observability, security, resiliency, and operational practices.
* Build platforms designed for large-scale and multi-tenant environments, with strong consideration for isolation, resource governance, high availability, failure recovery, and non-disruptive lifecycle operations.
* Establish measurable engineering and operational goals covering delivery predictability, product quality, reliability, performance, and engineering productivity.
* Partner with Quality Engineering, Support, and customer-facing teams to resolve complex field issues, drive root-cause analysis, and translate customer learnings into product and engineering improvements.
* Recruit, mentor, and retain strong engineering talent while developing senior engineers and technical leads into broader technical and organizational leadership roles.
* Create an environment of ownership and accountability where teams can make effective technical decisions and deliver customer outcomes with appropriate autonomy.
* Champion AI-assisted software development practices across the engineering organization, including the effective use of AI coding assistants and agentic development tools for design, implementation, testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and developer productivity, while establishing appropriate quality, security, and governance practices.
* Drive continuous improvement in developer experience and engineering productivity through modern development environments, automation, AI-assisted workflows, and measurable engineering practices.
* Identify dependencies and risks across engineering teams and drive alignment and resolution across organizational boundaries.
* Communicate engineering strategy, execution status, technical trade-offs, risks, and outcomes effectively to senior engineering and business leadership.
* Collaborate closely with globally distributed teams while continuing to build ClusterWareAI engineering capability and technical expertise in Bangalore.
* Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted software development approaches that improve engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate architecture, review, security, and quality standards.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **15+ years** of software engineering experience building enterprise software, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure software with **Practical exposure to Data Science, ML, GenAI, or AI/ML platforms.**
* 5+ years of engineering leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing software engineering teams.
* Experience leading multiple engineering initiatives, teams, or technical workstreams for a complex commercial software product or platform.
* Understanding of LLMs, RAG, AI agents, model serving, evaluation, and ML lifecycle.
* Ability to work effectively with Data Scientists and ML/AI Engineers.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
* Strong technical depth in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, and infrastructure software.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes, containers, Linux, REST/gRPC APIs, and modern service architectures.
* Experience designing and delivering highly available, scalable, resilient, and secure production software.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices including architecture and design reviews, Agile development, automated testing, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, and production operations.
* Ability to engage deeply in architecture and technical design discussions and provide effective guidance on complex engineering decisions.
* Experience owning software through the complete lifecycle—from requirements and architecture through development, deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to recruit, coach, mentor, and develop senior engineers and technical leaders.
* Demonstrated experience adopting AI-assisted software development tools and workflows, with an understanding of how to apply them effectively while maintaining code quality, security, architectural integrity, and engineering accountability.
* Strong customer and product mindset with the ability to translate customer requirements and operational challenges into engineering priorities.
* Experience collaborating effectively across Product Management, Architecture, Quality Engineering, Support, and other engineering organizations.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working with globally distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with one or more of the following:

* AI infrastructure, GPU cloud/neocloud platforms, or large-scale cloud infrastructure.
* Building cloud control planes, infrastructure management platforms, or orchestration systems.
* Kubernetes platform engineering and large-scale container orchestration.
* GPU infrastructure, heterogeneous accelerator environments, or GPU resource management.
* Bare-metal provisioning, fleet management, and infrastructure lifecycle automation.
* Multi-tenant platforms, resource scheduling, quotas, isolation, and infrastructure security.
* High-performance networking technologies including InfiniBand, RDMA/RoCE, and high-speed Ethernet.
* Distributed storage and data infrastructure.
* Infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Ansible.
* Observability, Site Reliability Engineering practices, service-level objectives, high availability, and automated remediation.
* Workload management and scheduling technologies such as Kubernetes and Slurm.
* Hybrid cloud and enterprise SaaS platforms.
* High Performance Computing environments.
* AI/ML platform infrastructure, LLM infrastructure, or AI-enabled infrastructure operations.
* Building or scaling engineering teams within a growing product or engineering organization.

**Location**

Hybrid – Bangalore, India

**Travel**

Less than 10%

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The mission of the Data Protection Understanding engineering team is to provide Google with technical solutions for making AI development in the company faster and safer, and also enable large-scale adoption of these solutions, via infra and automation. Applied Lineage - CFG team's mission is to build tools that empower teams with high-fidelity, distilled data lineage graphs that accurately represent data lineage and dependencies across Google's systems to enable policy enforcement, privacy compliance, and data governance. This allows product teams to focus on building their products, while the data protection and regulatory compliance is taken care of for them.

  
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

* Facilitate alignment and clarity across teams on goals, outcomes, and timelines.
* Manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.
* Collaborate with partner teams in Bangalore (in other organizations), cross-functional leads and key stakeholders globally.

title: Team Lead - Fullstack
description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Team Lead** to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview and Objective**

Responsible for guiding a software development team to deliver high‑value, performant, and secure software solutions. This role ensures that day‑to‑day development activities align with the R&D Department goals and processes.
  
  
The Team Lead provides direction, coaching, and technical oversight for developers through the design, implementation, and automated/integration testing of software. They work closely with the Project Lead (who owns project planning, status reporting, estimation, and delivery) to ensure work is executed effectively. The Team Lead focuses on people leadership, roadmap execution, and team performance, but may support the architecture and development if needed.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
  
As a **Team Lead** at Arctic Wolf, you will:

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of software engineers.
* Provide day-to-day technical guidance and remove obstacles impacting delivery.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and career development discussions.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and innovation.
* Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, tools, and team effectiveness.
* Build strong partnerships with Product Management, Architecture, Support, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Ensure adherence to software development standards, security policies, and engineering best practices.  

  

Technical Leadership & Software Delivery

* Guide the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of software solutions.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver roadmap commitments.
* Provide technical oversight on architecture, implementation, code quality, and troubleshooting activities.
* Promote secure coding practices, automated testing, and engineering excellence.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, reliability, and security requirements.
Support software development activities as needed through hands-on technical contributions.  

People Management & Operations

* Support team planning, capacity management, and resource allocation.
* Approve vacation requests, expenses, and training budgets.
* Partner with Engineering Leadership and HR on performance management and compensation planning.
* Participate in hiring activities, including candidate screening, interviewing, and selection.
* Support onboarding and development of new team members.

**Experience & Requirements**
-----------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in software development or a related technical role.
* Experience leading, mentoring, or providing technical direction to engineering teams.
* Strong background in designing, developing, and delivering software applications.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Experience driving engineering best practices, code quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and Agile practices.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Knowledge of secure coding standards, software security principles, and quality engineering practices.
* Ability to coach, mentor, and develop team members in a collaborative environment.
Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.  

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**About Arctic Wolf**

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

**Our Values**

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business and customer information.

  

Depending on the role, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**

As an Expert Fullstack Engineer focused on infrastructure, you will be a hands-on technical lead. You will design, build and run secure, scalable and resilient Generative AI solutions, including BeMind, BearingPoint's enterprise AI platform, from the application down to the cloud infrastructure. About half of your time goes to infrastructure, security and DevOps. The other half goes to backend and full-stack engineering.

**Primary Functions and Tasks:**

* DevOps & automation: evolve CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and automation of cloud resources, and make releases routine and low-risk.
* Containers & services: containerise applications, evolve architecture from monoliths towards services, and choose the right compute model (App Services, serverless, VMs, Kubernetes).
* AI infrastructure & APIs: run AI services such as Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry and AI Search, and expose, secure and govern APIs, including through API Management and as MCP servers.
* Full-stack engineering: build robust backend APIs and contribute to the frontend where platform knowledge is critical.
* Reliability: set up monitoring, logging and alerting, and drive performance and cost optimisation.
* Leadership: mentor colleagues, set architecture standards and explain complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**We are looking for:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (Master's degree or further cloud training is a plus), or equivalent practical experience.
* Around 8+ years of professional IT experience, including several years building
* and running production cloud infrastructure and doing backend / full-stack development.

* GCP experience is welcome if you are willing to become proficient in Azure quickly.

JOB TITLE: SENIOR BACKEND DEVELOPER – ASP.NET CORE | APIs | KUBERNETES | MESSAGING

Experience: 5–10+ Years

Location: Flexible / Hybrid

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a highly skilled Backend Developer with strong expertise in ASP.NET Core, RESTful API development, API Gateway technologies, NGINX, Kubernetes, and message queue-based architectures. The ideal candidate will design, develop, deploy, and support scalable microservices and backend platforms that power enterprise applications.

The role requires hands-on experience building cloud-native applications, implementing secure and high-performance APIs, containerizing applications, and integrating distributed systems using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Azure Service Bus. The candidate will collaborate with architects, DevOps engineers, frontend teams, QA, and product stakeholders to deliver reliable and maintainable solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Application Development

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using ASP.NET Core and modern .NET versions.

- Develop, document, version, and support RESTful APIs and microservices.

- Implement secure authentication and authorization using JWT, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and enterprise identity providers.

- Integrate APIs with internal platforms, databases, devices, and third-party enterprise systems.

2. API Management and NGINX

- Design and implement API Gateway solutions using NGINX, Kong, Apigee, Azure API Management, or Kubernetes Ingress Controllers.

- Configure routing, load balancing, TLS termination, throttling, caching, rate limiting, request transformation, and security policies.

- Maintain API specifications using Swagger/OpenAPI and enforce consistent API governance standards.

3. Containerization and Kubernetes

- Containerize backend services using Docker and deploy them to Kubernetes-based environments.

- Configure and maintain Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, Ingress, health probes, resource limits, and Horizontal Pod Autoscaling.

- Use Helm charts or equivalent deployment packaging and troubleshoot application issues across Kubernetes clusters.

4. Messaging and Event-Driven Architecture

- Design asynchronous, event-driven integrations using Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, ActiveMQ, or equivalent platforms.

- Build resilient message producers and consumers with idempotency, retries, dead-letter queues, ordering, and error-handling strategies.

- Monitor message processing, diagnose failures, and support reliable delivery across distributed services.

5. Performance, Reliability, and Support

- Optimize application performance, scalability, security, resilience, and availability.

- Implement structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, and alerting.

- Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

6. CI/CD, Quality, and Governance

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.

- Write unit, integration, contract, and automated tests using appropriate .NET testing frameworks.

- Participate in code reviews, architecture reviews, threat modeling, release readiness, and technical documentation.

- Follow secure coding practices, Agile delivery methods, SDLC controls, and enterprise engineering standards.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS

Backend:

C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, dependency injection, asynchronous programming.

API Engineering:

REST, Swagger/OpenAPI, API versioning, OAuth 2.0, JWT, OpenID Connect.

Gateway and Proxy:

NGINX, Kubernetes Ingress, and exposure to Kong, Apigee, or Azure API Management.

Containers:

Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AKS/EKS/OpenShift or equivalent managed platforms.

Messaging:

Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, ActiveMQ, event-driven architecture.

Data:

SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle; exposure to MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.

Engineering Tools:

Git, Azure DevOps/GitHub/Jenkins, Postman, SonarQube, CI/CD pipelines.

Testing:

xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, Moq, integration testing, API contract testing.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or another major cloud platform.

- Practical knowledge of microservices patterns, Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, event sourcing, or Dapr.

- Experience with Redis, gRPC, SignalR, service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep.

- Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Application Insights, or comparable observability platforms.

- Experience delivering high-availability, transportation, payment processing, fare collection, financial, or other enterprise systems.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

- Five or more years of professional backend development experience, including hands-on delivery with ASP.NET Core and API-based systems.

- Relevant Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, cloud, or security certifications are preferred.

CORE COMPETENCIES

- Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to design secure, scalable, testable, and maintainable distributed systems.

- Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong ownership, collaboration, prioritization, and production-support discipline.

- Ability to work effectively in Agile/Scrum and cross-functional teams.

title: Performance Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.

**All about the role**

As Performance Engineer, you will report directly to the Platform Engineering and SRE Engineering Manager.

The Performance Engineer will be part of our Cloud Native organization, will work closely with our Product teams in eCommerce, Digital Marketing and other Consumer solutions and be involved in the full Software Lifecycle. We already have a solid, modern Engineering foundation and want to continuously improve in a dynamic, iterative manner.

You'll own how we prove that our consumer platforms perform at scale: from understanding how customers really use our systems, through designing realistic load and performance tests, to finding bottlenecks and seeing the fixes through. This is both a creative and a detail-oriented role in a very multicultural environment. We want you to be bursting with opinions and passionate about sharing, as well as executing them in a collaborative way.

**About the CDI Experience Organization**

The Consumer Direct Interaction Experience Organization is a Digital Product Organization responsible for delivering tech solutions to our end-users and consumers across both pre-purchase and post-purchase journeys. We are organized in 15+ digital product areas, providing solutions ranging from Contact Center, E-commerce, Marketing, and Identity to AI.

At CDI XO, Electrolux Group's Consumer Direct Interaction Organization, we are transforming everyday life through digital innovation.

Our engineers help design and build solutions, big and small, to enable a range of highly connected Consumer Market solutions in a modern distributed landscape. Our new team members will be working at the cutting edge of Cloud Native technology and patterns. We strive to develop, build, deploy and run intelligently.

**What you'll do**

* Gather and analyse performance requirements and architectural dependencies with product teams, architects and business stakeholders.
* Build workload models from production evidence (observability data, gateway logs, real user monitoring) so that tests reflect how customers actually use our platforms.
* Design, develop, execute and monitor the full range of performance tests: load, stress, soak, spike and scalability, at both API and client side.
* Create and maintain performance testing frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines so performance is checked continuously, not just before a release.
* Automate manual and repetitive performance testing activities, and treat test scripts, configuration and dashboards as code (no point and click).
* Analyse application, infrastructure and database performance issues, find complex bottlenecks, and drive tuning initiatives through to completion.

Work across a stack that includes:

* Observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, and Azure Monitor.
* Enterprise SaaS and PaaS systems in the eCommerce, Finance and Logistics arenas.
* Cloud-native architectures on Microsoft Azure, including Kubernetes and microservices.
* Build performance dashboards, prepare reports and give clear, evidence-based updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage test environments and test data, and make the gaps between test and production environments visible.
* Work with SRE colleagues to tie performance targets to SLOs and SLIs, and use test results to protect Error Budgets.
* Identify risks and issues early, and give actionable recommendations.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps teams and business stakeholders to choose the right design solutions and make sure performance objectives are met.
* Mentor engineers in performance engineering practices, and stay current with tools and industry trends.

But…the most important thing is that you are genuinely passionate about performance engineering and continuous improvement.

**Who are you**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in performance testing and engineering.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Apache JMeter.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with BlazeMeter.
* Strong monitoring experience with Dynatrace and Datadog.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Proficiency in scripting with Java, Python and/or JavaScript.
* Strong experience automating performance testing, with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Good knowledge of SQL and databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience with client-side performance testing and performance monitoring dashboards.
* Proven ability to identify complex performance bottlenecks and give optimisation recommendations.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, microservices and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including requirement gathering, stakeholder management and sprint-based delivery.
* Experience working with customers to understand deployment architectures and use cases.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and communication skills; self-driven, flexible and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer Science/Software Engineering related degree.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

**Desirable qualifications and experience**

* Knowledge of AWS.
* Heap dump and thread dump analysis.
* Experience with Git.
* Experience with SAP systems, particularly SAP Commerce Cloud.
* Strong understanding of Datadog RUM.

**Where you'll be**

This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India. Immediate joiners are preferred.

**Benefits Highlights**

* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work environment
* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services
* Family-friendly benefits
* Extensive learning opportunities and a flexible career path

title: Technical Lead – Java
description:
### **Job Type:**


Permanent


### **Experience:**


8 \- 12 Years


### **Location:**


Bangalore


#### **Life at EvoluteIQ:**


We at EvoluteIQ believe in the power of transformation. We are committed to building a industry\-leading technology that will revolutionize the way enterprises conduct business.


To make that happen, we need people who are generous, genuine, self\-driven and collaborative. People who not only want to be a part of a fast\-growing and radical thinking company, but who are kind and care—about each other. We at EvoluteIQ thrive in the company of each other and make each other a better version of ourselves every day.


**Could that be you?**


#### **The EIQ Mission:**


Our culture is who we are, and it defines us. We are nimble, fast, dedicated, humble and bold. We see opportunities everywhere around us to make a **“dent in the universe”.** Our core fabric is Innovation! And this is not just a word, but the way of life within EvoluteIQ.


Changing the way business is done, reimagining the future of work, and enabling people to improve their quality of work every day, is a daunting task. That is what we all strive every day at EvoluteIQ. To enable everyone to automate complicated processes with their instinct and knowledge.


We make building of automation simple for everyone, so that it is not mystery for a few.


**Would you like to be part of this journey?**


We are looking for a strong, hands\-on **Java Technical Lead** who combines deep engineering capability with architecture, problem solving, design leadership, team guidance, and delivery ownership. The role is expected to understand and influence the complete application stack – from browser and network protocols through Java services, databases, messaging, infrastructure, security, scalability, deployment, and production operations. This is not a coordination\-only role. The Technical Lead must remain close to the code, be capable of diagnosing difficult technical issues, review critical implementations, make sound architecture decisions, and ensure that the team produces maintainable, scalable, secure, and production\-ready software.


##### **1\. End\-to\-End Architecture \& Solution Design**


* Own the technical design of major features, modules, integrations, and services from requirements through production deployment.
* Understand the complete request flow: browser/client \-\> DNS \-\> TCP/IP \-\> SSL/TLS \-\> HTTPS \-\> WAF/load balancer/reverse proxy \-\> application/API layer \-\> Java services \-\> cache/messaging \-\> databases \-\> infrastructure.
* Select appropriate architectural patterns and technologies based on functional requirements, system constraints, operability, and long\-term maintainability.
* Design stateless/stateful services, synchronous/asynchronous interactions, clustering, horizontal/vertical scaling, caching, distributed processing, failover, and resilience mechanisms.
* Identify architecture risks, bottlenecks, capacity constraints, integration concerns, and failure modes early in the lifecycle.
##### **2\. Hands\-on Java \& JVM Engineering**


* Provide hands\-on technical leadership in modern Java development and remain capable of implementing, debugging, profiling, and reviewing complex production code.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Java language fundamentals, collections, generics, exception handling, I/O, concurrency, synchronization, thread pools, executors, CompletableFuture, and asynchronous programming patterns.
* Understand JVM behaviour including heap/non\-heap memory, garbage collection, class loading, thread dumps, heap dumps, JVM tuning, profiling, memory leaks, CPU bottlenecks, and performance diagnostics.
* Apply clean code principles, SOLID concepts, design patterns, modularity, testability, defensive programming, and appropriate abstraction.
* Perform code reviews for correctness, performance, security, maintainability, concurrency safety, error handling, observability, and alignment with architecture.
##### **3\. Spring, APIs \& Middle\-Tier Engineering**


* Strong working experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot, including dependency injection, configuration, security, validation, persistence, transactions, and application lifecycle.
* Design RESTful APIs and service contracts with appropriate versioning, validation, error models, idempotency, pagination, timeout/retry behaviour, and backward compatibility.
* Understand microservices and modular monolith trade\-offs; design service boundaries, inter\-service communication, configuration, discovery, resilience, and dependency management appropriately.
* Experience with JPA/Hibernate or equivalent ORM technologies and awareness of ORM performance problems such as N\+1 queries, lazy loading, transaction scope, and inefficient object graphs.
* Understand web/application servers, connection/thread pools, reverse proxies, request handling, serialization, session management, and middle\-tier performance behaviour.
##### **4\. Database, Cache, Search \& Messaging**


* Strong RDBMS knowledge covering MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server or equivalent technologies.
* Design schemas and data models; understand indexing, query plans, SQL optimization, transactions, isolation levels, locking, deadlocks, connection pooling, replication, partitioning, high availability, and database scalability.
* Understand when relational, document, key\-value, search, or distributed data stores are appropriate.
* Working knowledge of technologies such as Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Cassandra or equivalents.
* Design asynchronous and event\-driven flows using Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ or equivalent messaging platforms; understand delivery semantics, ordering, retries, dead\-letter handling, consumer scaling, and idempotency.
##### **5\. Web, Network \& Security Fundamentals**


* Strong understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, certificates, DNS, TCP/IP fundamentals, proxies, reverse proxies, load balancers, firewalls/WAFs, and secure service\-to\-service communication.
* Understand authentication and authorization patterns including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, SSO, identity providers, RBAC, token/session lifecycle, and secrets handling.
* Apply API and application security fundamentals including input validation, secure headers, transport security, least privilege, secrets management, dependency hygiene, and common web vulnerability mitigation.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, database, network, certificate, proxy, load\-balancing, and infrastructure layers rather than viewing the Java application in isolation.
##### **6\. High\-Level \& Low\-Level Design**


* Own and prepare High\-Level Designs (HLDs) for significant product capabilities and customer\-facing solutions.
* Document architecture, components, responsibilities, integration points, deployment topology, data flows, interfaces, security considerations, technology choices, assumptions, and NFRs.
* Break HLDs into implementable components and guide engineers in preparing Low\-Level Designs (LLDs), class/component designs, sequence diagrams, API specifications, schemas, and detailed integration logic.
* Review and validate LLDs before implementation and verify that delivered code remains aligned to approved architecture and design.
* Maintain design decision records and technical documentation at a level that supports engineering, supportability, future enhancement, and knowledge transfer.
##### **7\. Non\-Functional Requirements \& Production Engineering**


* Take explicit ownership of performance, scalability, availability, reliability, resilience, security, maintainability, extensibility, observability, auditability, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, and capacity considerations.
* Translate NFRs into measurable design and engineering requirements rather than treating them as late\-stage testing concerns.
* Define appropriate timeouts, retries, circuit\-breaking, resource limits, thread/connection pools, caching, queue sizing, health checks, graceful degradation, and failure\-handling behaviour.
* Work with QA/Performance/DevOps teams to validate NFRs through performance, load, resilience, failover, security, and operational readiness testing.
* Ensure production telemetry is sufficient for diagnosis through structured logging, metrics, traces, alerts, correlation IDs, dashboards, and actionable health indicators.
##### **8\. Problem Solving, Troubleshooting \& Root\-Cause Analysis**


* Demonstrate strong analytical problem solving and the ability to break down complex issues systematically.
* Diagnose performance degradation, memory problems, CPU spikes, deadlocks, thread starvation, slow database queries, network latency, connection exhaustion, message backlogs, and integration failures.
* Use logs, metrics, thread dumps, heap dumps, profilers, query plans, traces, operating\-system indicators, and infrastructure telemetry to isolate causes.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions rather than temporary workarounds.
* Lead the engineering response for difficult production incidents and customer\-critical technical problems when required.
##### **9\. WBS, Estimation \& Delivery Planning**


* Translate requirements and designs into clear technical work packages and implementation plans.
* Prepare and/or validate Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), ensuring tasks are sufficiently decomposed for execution and tracking.
* Prepare and validate estimates for design, development, unit testing, integration, documentation, security, performance, deployment, and production\-readiness activities.
* Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks, unknowns, external interfaces, and critical technical sequencing before commitments are made.
* Work closely with Project Management to track technical progress, resolve blockers, highlight delivery risks early, and maintain realistic implementation plans.
##### **10\. Product Management \& Requirement Collaboration**


* Work closely with Product Management to understand business objectives, user journeys, product requirements, priorities, and acceptance criteria.
* Challenge ambiguous or incomplete requirements constructively and identify missing technical, data, integration, error\-handling, security, and NFR considerations.
* Provide feasibility assessments, technical options, trade\-offs, dependencies, and cost/complexity implications to support product decisions.
* Participate in backlog refinement and ensure that requirements are technically actionable before they enter development.
* Translate product intent into a solution that the engineering team can design, estimate, implement, test, and support.
##### **11\. Technical Leadership \& Team Development**


* Lead and mentor Java/backend engineers while setting a high bar for engineering quality and ownership.
* Guide developers in architecture, detailed design, coding, debugging, testing, performance, and production support practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and technical walkthroughs.
* Delegate detailed engineering ownership appropriately while remaining accountable for overall technical quality.
* Establish reusable patterns, coding standards, engineering guidelines, and review practices.
* Identify and manage technical debt, refactoring needs, obsolete dependencies, and structural weaknesses in the codebase.
* Improve the team’s capability to independently perform LLD, estimation, troubleshooting, and production\-quality engineering.
#### **What you'll do at EvoluteIQ:**


* Java 11/17/21 or comparable modern Java versions; strong core Java and JVM fundamentals.
* Spring Framework / Spring Boot; Spring Security and related ecosystem experience preferred.
* REST APIs, web services, microservices and distributed application architecture.
* JPA/Hibernate or equivalent persistence technologies.
* RDBMS and SQL; schema design, transaction management, query optimisation and performance tuning.
* NoSQL/cache/search technologies such as Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch or equivalent.
* Messaging/event technologies such as Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ or equivalent.
* HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, DNS, OAuth2/OIDC/JWT, API security and certificate fundamentals.
* Linux, NGINX/reverse proxies, load balancing and clustering concepts.
* Docker, Kubernetes fundamentals, CI/CD, cloud deployment concepts and observability tooling.
* Performance engineering, JVM troubleshooting, profiling, logging, metrics and distributed system diagnostics.
* HLD/LLD, architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, API contracts, data modelling, design patterns and technical documentation.
#### **What will you bring to the team?**


* Typically 8\-12\+ years of software engineering experience with substantial hands\-on Java/backend development.
* At least 2\-4\+ years in a Technical Lead, Lead Engineer, Senior Technical Architect or equivalent role with direct engineering ownership.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise\-grade or large\-scale web applications from design through production.
* Demonstrated experience leading developers through HLD/LLD, implementation, code review, testing, deployment and production support.
* Experience working closely with Product Managers, Project Managers, Architects, QA, DevOps/SRE, security teams and other engineering stakeholders.
#### **Must\-have:**


* The ideal candidate can move comfortably across the complete engineering lifecycle: Requirement \-\> Architecture \-\> HLD \-\> LLD \-\> WBS \-\> Estimation \-\> Hands\-on Development \-\> Code Review \-\> Testing \-\> Deployment \-\> Production Troubleshooting.
* Most importantly, this person should think beyond the Java codebase. They should understand how the full system behaves, be able to trace problems across layers, make sound engineering trade\-offs, and provide the technical leadership required to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, maintainable, and operable software.
#### **What We Offer:**


* Opportunity to shape the strategy of a next\-gen hyper\-automation platform.
* Work with a cross\-disciplinary team in a fast\-growing, innovation\-driven environment.
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunities.
* A culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
Ready to take the next step in your career journey with us? Apply now and become part of a dynamic team that values expertise, collaboration, and a positive work culture!


Don’t Meet Every Requirement? We Still Want to Hear From You!


Please go ahead and apply anyway.


We know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes and passion can’t be learned. If you believe, then we would like to meet you and explore that belief!


We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Infrastructure Engineer Intern**
----------------------------------

**Location:** Bangalore – Brookfield**Department:** IT Infrastructure / Technology**Employment Type:** Internship – Full\-Time**Working Hours:** 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday (Alternate Saturdays Off)**Experience:** Fresher / Recent Graduate / Intern### **About the Role**


We are looking for a motivated and technically strong **Infrastructure Engineer Intern** to join our IT Infrastructure and Technology team.
The candidate will receive hands\-on exposure to:  

* Server administration
* Virtualization
* Networking
* Endpoint support
* Operating systems
* Monitoring
* Cybersecurity
* Backups
* Databases
* Application platforms
* Infrastructure operations


The candidate must also have a **basic understanding of Frontend, Backend, and Full\-Stack development**, as the role involves supporting the infrastructure on which business applications and software platforms operate.
The ideal candidate should be interested in building a career in:  

* Infrastructure Engineering
* System Administration
* Network Administration
* DevOps
* Cloud Infrastructure
* IT Operations

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1\. Infrastructure Management**
---------------------------------

* Assist in deploying, configuring, and maintaining on\-premises physical servers.
* Support environments consisting of multiple physical servers and virtual machines.
* Assist in managing servers deployed at client locations.
* Support virtualization environments and VM lifecycle management.
* Assist with VM creation, configuration, maintenance, backup, and decommissioning.
* Assist with IP allocation and network configuration.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation and configuration records.
* Support infrastructure capacity and resource monitoring.

**2\. Server Management**
-------------------------

* Assist in administering Linux, Windows, and macOS environments.
* Gain exposure to Dell and HP physical servers.
* Monitor server health and system performance.
* Assist in troubleshooting CPU, memory, storage, and performance issues.
* Monitor server availability and application services.
* Assist with database server and application platform administration.
* Perform basic server maintenance under supervision.
* Assist with patching, updates, and routine infrastructure activities.

**3\. End\-User Device \& Desktop Support**
-------------------------------------------

* Provide first\-level technical support for laptops, desktops, printers, and peripherals.
* Diagnose and resolve basic hardware and software issues.
* Troubleshoot driver and peripheral connectivity problems.
* Install and configure operating systems and applications.
* Prepare, image, and configure laptops/desktops for new employees.
* Support employee onboarding and IT setup.
* Maintain proper records of assigned IT equipment.

**4\. Operating System Administration**
---------------------------------------


Assist with installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of:  

* Windows
* Ubuntu/Linux
* macOS

**Responsibilities include:**  

* OS installation and configuration.
* Software and application installation.
* Driver troubleshooting.
* OS updates and patching.
* Boot and startup troubleshooting.
* Performance troubleshooting.
* Application compatibility troubleshooting.
* Basic system security configuration.

**5\. Network Infrastructure Management**
-----------------------------------------

* Assist in configuring and troubleshooting network switches.
* Support routers and wireless access points.
* Troubleshoot LAN and Wi\-Fi connectivity.
* Assist with IP addressing and network configuration.
* Understand basic VLAN and network segmentation concepts.
* Assist with firewall configuration and monitoring.
* Monitor firewall logs and identify unusual traffic.
* Assist with VPN configuration and remote connectivity.
* Support secure external access.
* Assist with periodic firewall rule reviews.
* Learn basic network performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot connectivity, latency, and network performance issues.

**6\. Endpoint Security \& Antivirus Management**
-------------------------------------------------

* Assist in deploying and managing Seqrite Antivirus and Endpoint Security.
* Monitor endpoint security status.
* Monitor malware and virus alerts.
* Assist with quarantine and security incident handling.
* Ensure endpoint definitions and security policies remain updated.
* Assist with endpoint security agent installation.
* Troubleshoot antivirus agent connectivity and installation issues.
* Maintain basic endpoint security documentation.

**7\. Infrastructure Monitoring**
---------------------------------


Assist in administering and maintaining:  

* Zabbix
* Uptime Monitoring
* Grafana
* SigNoz

**Responsibilities include:**  

* Monitor server availability.
* Monitor VM availability.
* Track CPU utilization.
* Track memory utilization.
* Monitor disk and storage utilization.
* Monitor application and service availability.
* Review alerts and logs.
* Assist in troubleshooting infrastructure alerts.
* Maintain monitoring dashboards.
* Support proactive infrastructure monitoring.

**8\. CCTV Infrastructure Support**
-----------------------------------

* Monitor CCTV system health and uptime.
* Ensure network connectivity to CCTV cameras.
* Troubleshoot basic camera connectivity issues.
* Monitor video feed availability.
* Assist with CCTV hardware and software troubleshooting.
* Monitor CCTV storage.
* Assist with surveillance footage archiving.
* Ensure required retention policies are followed.

**9\. Backup \& Storage Management**
------------------------------------

* Assist in maintaining backup infrastructure.
* Monitor scheduled backups.
* Verify successful completion of backups.
* Identify and report backup failures.
* Assist with database and server backup activities.
* Perform basic backup validation.
* Assist with restoration testing.
* Maintain backup documentation.
* Gain practical exposure to disaster recovery concepts.

**10\. IT Asset Management**
----------------------------

* Maintain hardware and software inventory.
* Track laptops, desktops, servers, monitors, printers, and networking equipment.
* Maintain asset allocation records.
* Track asset lifecycle and replacement requirements.
* Assist with procurement activities.
* Maintain infrastructure and asset documentation.
* Ensure proper handover and return of IT assets.

**11\. Core Platform Services**
-------------------------------

* Gain practical exposure to LDAP and directory services.
* Assist with basic identity and access management.
* Support user and system access activities under supervision.
* Maintain infrastructure room and server room documentation.
* Assist with physical infrastructure inspections.
* Maintain proper organization of network and server equipment.
* Follow infrastructure security and operational procedures.

**12\. Frontend Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
===================================================


The candidate must have basic knowledge of **Frontend development**.### **Required Understanding**

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* Basic frontend application architecture.
* Basic understanding of browser and client\-server communication.
* Understanding of frontend build and deployment concepts.
* Basic understanding of API integration.
* Basic troubleshooting of frontend application issues.

### **Preferred**

* React
* Angular
* Vue.js
* npm
* Frontend build tools


The candidate should understand how a frontend application is hosted, deployed, accessed, and connected to backend services.**13\. Backend Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
==================================================


The candidate must have basic knowledge of **Backend development**.### **Required Understanding**

* Basic backend application architecture.
* REST APIs.
* HTTP/HTTPS.
* API requests and responses.
* Authentication and authorization concepts.
* Application\-server communication.
* Basic backend troubleshooting.
* Basic database connectivity.

### **Backend Technologies**


Candidate should have exposure to at least one backend technology/language such as:  

* Java
* Python
* Node.js
* PHP
* .NET


The candidate should be able to understand how backend applications run on servers and communicate with databases and frontend applications.**14\. Full\-Stack Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
======================================================


The candidate must have a basic understanding of **Full\-Stack application architecture**.
The candidate should understand the relationship between:**Frontend API/Backend Database Backend Frontend**### **Basic Knowledge Should Include**

* Frontend application structure.
* Backend/API structure.
* Database interaction.
* REST APIs.
* Application deployment.
* Server\-side application hosting.
* Basic application troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of logs and application errors.
* Basic understanding of application\-server communication.


The candidate is **not required to be an expert Full\-Stack Developer**, but must understand how a complete application works across frontend, backend, database, server, and network layers.**15\. Database Knowledge – MANDATORY**
=======================================

* Basic understanding of databases.
* Basic SQL knowledge.
* Understanding of tables, records, and queries.
* Basic knowledge of relational databases.
* Understanding of application\-to\-database connectivity.
* Basic database troubleshooting.

### **Preferred Database Exposure**

* MySQL
* PostgreSQL
* SQL Server
* Similar databases

**16\. DevOps \& Development Tools**
====================================


Basic exposure to the following will be an advantage:  

* Git
* GitHub/GitLab
* Docker
* CI/CD concepts
* Build and deployment processes
* Shell scripting
* Python scripting
* Linux command line
* Application logs
* Environment variables
* Basic cloud concepts

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
==============================


The candidate must have basic knowledge or academic/project exposure to:### **Infrastructure**

* Infrastructure
* Linux/Ubuntu
* Windows
* Computer hardware
* Servers
* Virtual machines

### **Networking**

* Networking fundamentals
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* DHCP
* LAN/Wi\-Fi
* Routers and switches
* Basic firewall concepts

### **Development**

* **Frontend – Mandatory**
* **Backend – Mandatory**
* **Full\-Stack concepts – Mandatory**
* **Database/SQL – Mandatory**
* REST APIs
* HTTP/HTTPS
* Basic application architecture

### **Security \& Monitoring**

* Basic cybersecurity concepts
* Antivirus/Endpoint Security
* System monitoring
* Logs and troubleshooting

**Preferred Technical Exposure**
================================


Candidates having exposure to the following will be preferred:  

* Zabbix
* Grafana
* SigNoz
* Uptime Monitoring
* Docker
* Git/GitHub
* CI/CD
* Shell scripting
* Python
* LDAP
* Active Directory
* VPN
* Firewall administration
* Cloud platforms
* Database administration
* Backup and disaster recovery

**Educational Qualification**
=============================

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
* BCA / MCA or equivalent IT qualification.
* Freshers and recent graduates are welcome.
* Candidates with academic projects in Infrastructure, Networking, DevOps, Full\-Stack Development, or System Administration are preferred.

**Candidate Profile**
=====================


We are looking for someone who:  

* Has a strong interest in IT Infrastructure and Technology.
* Has basic knowledge of both Infrastructure and Software Development.
* Is comfortable working with Linux and Windows.
* Understands basic networking concepts.
* Has basic Frontend, Backend, and Full\-Stack knowledge.
* Has good troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Is willing to work hands\-on with servers, networks, systems, and applications.
* Can learn new technologies quickly.
* Has good communication and teamwork skills.
* Is willing to work in an onsite infrastructure environment.

**Key Learning Opportunities**
==============================


During the internship, the candidate will gain practical exposure to:  

* Server administration
* Linux administration
* Windows administration
* Virtualization
* Networking
* Firewalls and VPN
* Endpoint security
* Zabbix and Grafana monitoring
* Application monitoring
* Database environments
* Backup and disaster recovery
* CCTV infrastructure
* IT asset management
* LDAP
* Frontend applications
* Backend applications
* Full\-Stack architecture
* APIs
* Application deployment
* DevOps fundamentals
* Infrastructure troubleshooting

**Career Path**
===============


This internship can provide a foundation for careers in:  

* Infrastructure Engineer
* System Administrator
* Network Engineer
* DevOps Engineer
* Cloud Engineer
* IT Operations Engineer
* Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
* Application Support Engineer
* Full\-Stack Infrastructure/Platform Engineer

**Internship\-to\-Hire**
========================


Based on **performance, technical skills, learning ability, discipline, and organizational requirements**, the successful intern may be considered for a **full\-time employment opportunity after completion of the internship**.**Important Requirement**
=========================


Candidates with only basic desktop\-support knowledge and no understanding of **Frontend, Backend, Full\-Stack, APIs, and databases** will not be considered suitable for this position.
The role requires a combination of:**Infrastructure \+ Networking \+ Systems \+ Application \+ Development knowledge.**

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Senior Full\-Stack Engineer – Scalable AI Applications**

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Full\-Stack Engineer** to join our engineering team and take ownership of building and scaling complex features for a **live, production\-grade AI\-powered platform**.

This is not a conventional full\-stack role focused primarily on standard web development. The platform is already in production and growing, and the engineering challenges involve **scalability, real\-time processing, AI integration, application performance, reliability, and evolving product architecture**.

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys solving problems where the implementation path may not be immediately obvious. You should be comfortable investigating complex technical challenges, evaluating alternative approaches, understanding trade\-offs, and taking solutions from architecture through production.

You will work hands\-on across **React, Python, Django, databases, APIs, caching, asynchronous processing, real\-time communication, cloud infrastructure, and AI integrations**, while collaborating closely with AI engineers and senior technology leaders.

Key ResponsibilitiesFull\-Stack Product Engineering

* Design, develop, and own complex product features across both **frontend and backend systems**.
* Build scalable, responsive, and maintainable frontend applications using **React**.
* Design and develop high\-performance backend services and APIs using **Python and Django**.
* Take complete ownership of technical problems from **investigation and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production troubleshooting**.
* Build reusable and maintainable components that support continuous product evolution.

Scalability \& Performance Engineering

* Design applications capable of scaling to **100,000\+ registered users, 10,000\+ daily active users, and 100\+ concurrent users**.
* Build and optimize systems supporting **real\-time user interactions and high levels of concurrent application traffic**.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, databases, AI services, and infrastructure.
* Apply appropriate scalability patterns including:
* Caching
* Asynchronous processing
* Background jobs
* Message queues
* Database optimization
* Load balancing
* Horizontal scaling
* WebSockets and real\-time communication
* API optimization
* Rate limiting
* Conduct performance analysis and help improve application response times, throughput, and resource utilization.

AI \& LLM Integration

* Collaborate closely with AI engineers to integrate **LLMs, AI APIs, machine\-learning services, and AI models** into production applications.
* Build application workflows around **RAG pipelines, vector search, AI\-powered search, streaming LLM responses, and real\-time AI interactions**.
* Design robust application interfaces between AI services and the core product.
* Handle challenges such as AI service latency, streaming responses, failures, retries, timeouts, and concurrent AI requests.
* Help translate AI capabilities into scalable, reliable, user\-facing product features.

Architecture \& Engineering

* Participate actively in application and platform architecture discussions.
* Work with senior engineering and technology leaders to design architecture for new product capabilities.
* Evaluate different implementation approaches based on **scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and development effort**.
* Break down complex technical requirements into clear and practical implementation approaches.
* Continuously improve existing architecture as product usage and technical requirements evolve.
* Identify technical debt and recommend practical approaches for addressing it.

Production Reliability \& Troubleshooting

* Diagnose complex production issues and identify **root causes rather than relying on temporary fixes**.
* Improve the reliability, maintainability, observability, and performance of production systems.
* Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, error handling, alerting, and application health mechanisms.
* Proactively identify scalability and reliability risks before they become production issues.
* Support production deployments and troubleshoot issues across application and infrastructure layers.

Engineering Leadership \& Mentorship

* Maintain high standards for code quality, testing, documentation, and engineering practices.
* Conduct code reviews and review technical approaches proposed by other engineers.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
* Help team members improve their engineering quality, architecture thinking, debugging, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Share technical knowledge, engineering practices, and lessons learned across the team.
* Contribute to building a strong engineering culture focused on **ownership, quality, experimentation, and continuous improvement**.

What We Are Looking ForCore Technical Skills

* **5\+ years of professional software engineering experience**, preferably building and operating production applications.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **React and modern frontend development**.
* Strong backend development experience with **Python and Django**.
* Strong understanding of **REST APIs, application architecture, authentication, databases, and backend system design**.
* Experience designing, building, or operating applications supporting significant user traffic and concurrency.
* Strong understanding of relational databases and practical experience with database design, indexing, query optimization, and performance tuning.
* Experience working with caching, asynchronous processing, background jobs, and queues.
* Understanding of **WebSockets, Server\-Sent Events, or similar real\-time communication approaches**.
* Experience diagnosing production performance, scalability, and reliability issues.
* Good understanding of cloud\-native application architecture and deployment practices.

Problem\-Solving \& Ownership

We are particularly interested in engineers who are motivated by difficult technical problems.

You should be someone who can:

* Independently investigate unfamiliar technical problems.
* Understand the root cause before deciding on a solution.
* Research and evaluate alternative technical approaches.
* Work effectively when requirements or implementation paths are ambiguous.
* Make informed engineering trade\-offs between **speed, scalability, maintainability, and quality**.
* Challenge existing approaches constructively when a better solution is available.
* Take ownership rather than waiting for detailed technical instructions.
* Stay persistent when the first implementation approach does not work.
* Think beyond the immediate feature and consider its long\-term impact on the platform.

Technology Landscape

You should have strong experience with several of the following technologies or equivalent platforms:

**Frontend:**  
React, JavaScript/TypeScript, modern frontend frameworks and libraries

**Backend:**  
Python, Django, Django REST Framework, REST APIs

**Data \& Caching:**  
PostgreSQL/MySQL, Redis, database indexing and optimization

**Async \& Real\-Time:**  
Celery, message queues, background workers, WebSockets, Server\-Sent Events

**AI:**  
LLM APIs, AI/ML services, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, streaming AI responses

**Cloud:**  
AWS, EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Load Balancers, Lambda, Redis/ElastiCache or equivalent services

**DevOps \& Operations:**  
Docker, CI/CD, application monitoring, centralized logging, observability, performance monitoring

Nice to Have

* Experience building **high\-concurrency or real\-time applications**.
* Experience architecting applications on **AWS or another major cloud platform**.
* Experience with **Redis, Celery, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, or similar messaging technologies**.
* Experience integrating **LLMs or AI APIs into production applications**.
* Experience implementing **RAG and AI\-powered search solutions**.
* Experience with vector databases or semantic search technologies.
* Experience building applications with streaming AI responses.
* Experience with Docker and containerized production environments.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, tracing, and production observability.
* Experience conducting application performance testing and optimization.
* Experience working in a **startup, product company, or rapidly scaling technology environment**.

Mindset We Value

We value engineers who:

* **Enjoy difficult problems** rather than avoiding them.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of what they build.
* Are comfortable operating with ambiguity.
* Investigate problems deeply instead of applying temporary fixes.
* Learn unfamiliar technologies when required.
* Think about scalability before scalability becomes a problem.
* Consider production reliability as part of development.
* Proactively identify technical risks.
* Communicate technical trade\-offs clearly.
* Challenge assumptions when better approaches are possible.
* Balance engineering excellence with the execution speed required in a growing organization.
* Help other engineers become better problem solvers.

Why Join This Role

This is an opportunity to work on a **live, rapidly evolving AI platform** where engineering decisions directly influence product performance, scalability, reliability, and user experience.

You will not simply receive predefined development tasks. You will be expected to **understand the underlying problem, participate in solution architecture, evaluate technical approaches, build the solution, and take ownership of its performance in production**.

You will work at the intersection of **full\-stack engineering, scalable application architecture, cloud infrastructure, real\-time systems, and Generative AI**.

If you enjoy building sophisticated applications, solving problems without obvious answers, and taking meaningful ownership of how a technology platform evolves, this role provides the opportunity to do exactly that.

===============


As a SSE II, you'll define technical strategy, lead technology adoption, mentor junior engineers, and ensure project success. You'll review code, solve complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams. Your role includes driving innovation, maintaining documentation, optimizing performance, and implementing continuous improvements, making a significant impact on our engineering excellence and success. Join us to lead, innovate, and shape our technology's future!

**What we have for you –**

We are offering an exciting opportunity for a talented Staff Engineer to lead and work on cutting\-edge cloud\-native technologies. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing and developing microservices to build the next generation of Title and Escrow APIs, serving all divisions of First American. Join us to drive innovation, shape our technology landscape, and make a significant impact across the organization.

**Responsibilities and Duties**


As a SSE II, you will work closely with the Engineering Manager, Architect, Product Manager and team.

* Define and communicate the technical vision and strategy for projects.
* Lead the adoption and integration of new technologies and best practices.
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers.
* Conduct technical workshops and training sessions to upskill the team.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, timelines, and milestones.
* Coordinate with project managers to ensure timely and successful project delivery.
* Review code for quality, performance, security, and adherence to standards.
* Resolve complex technical challenges and bottlenecks using advanced techniques.
* Perform root cause analysis to identify and address underlying issues.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to align technical solutions with business goals.
* Communicate technical updates and progress to non\-technical stakeholders effectively.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and develop prototypes and proof\-of\-concept projects.
* Implement continuous process improvements and best practices.
* Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including system architecture and design decisions.
* Analyze and optimize system performance, implementing tuning and scaling strategies.

**Technology Stack**


An ideal candidate should have understanding and hands\-on experience with following technologies:


* 7\+ years with Microsoft technologies: Python, TypeScript \& NestJS
* 7\+ years with one of the modern UI frameworks: React.js, Angular
* 5\+ years with cloud platforms (AWS preferred): EC2, S3, Lambda, EFS, ECS, EKS, API Gateway, SQS, IAM, VPC
* At least 4\+ years’ experience in designing and architecting systems and exposure to different patterns and solutions.
* At least 4\+ years’ experience with CI/CD tools: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, YAML, PowerShell

* Relational (MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB, DocumentDB, OpenSearch/ElasticSearch) databases
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes
* Familiarity Exposure to observability tools: Splunk, ELK Stack, DataDog
* Experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
* Knowledge on DataBricks with Python is an added advantage.
* AWS/Azure developer and architect certification is a plus.
